_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Do not fret because of the wicked; trust in the Lord and do good.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
You meant it for harm; God meant it for good.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
Love your enemies, and do good, expecting nothing in return.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Picture a brother who was sold, given up for dead, standing now with power over the ones who wronged him.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
And instead of revenge, he weeps and forgives: you meant evil, but God turned it to life.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
This is the hard, holy way: love your enemies, bless those who curse you, give without keeping score.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
Forgive, and you will be forgiven; the measure you give is the measure you will get back.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The wronged brother weeps and forgives.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
You meant evil; God turned it to life.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
Love your enemies; give without keeping score.
Be merciful, as your Father is merciful. Amen.
